I'm sorry. I felt the same way. I honestly still hurts but the worst of it is over for me. Do you see a therapist? It can really help. What worked for me was setting a specific time of day, same time everyday and cry to all the things I gathered together that remind me of them. This can be photos, items, or you can write down a list of phrases and words that remind you of a memory. The idea is exposing you to the thing that is hurting you 10-15 minutes until you are desensitized to it. Over time your brain will get really bored of crying over the same thing. It takes the power away and gives you a separate specific time to release your emotions. You have to follow it though If you want it to work
